title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
GurugramFull-timeSeniorOn-site

  

**Description**
---------------

**About Coralogix**

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.

We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.

**The Role**

Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.

Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.

A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.

  
  

**What You Will Build**

**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade
  

  

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets
  

  

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data
  

  

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  

  

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones
  

  

**Cultural Fit**

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.

  
Responsibilities:

Architecture and Design

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

Qualifications:

Required

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

title: Assistant Manager QA
description:
The **Assistant QA Manager** is responsible for overseeing and enforcing compliance, document control, and shop-floor quality operations in accordance with cGMP, WHO-GMP, and statutory regulations. Key responsibilities include drug regulatory authorities, ensuring accurate and timely issuance and review of Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packaging Records (BPR), acting as the central custodian for all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and actively embedding a robust quality-first culture across all manufacturing operations

Key Responsibilities1. Government & Regulatory Liaison

* Serve as the primary point of contact for local and national drug control authorities (e.g., State FDA, CDSCO).
* Coordinate, prepare, and submit documentation required for manufacturing license endorsements, renewals, COPP (Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product), neutral code approvals, and site master files (SMF).
* Assist during official regulatory inspections and audits; lead the preparation of pre-audit checklists, audit rooms, and post-audit compliance reports (CAPA).
* Track and interpret revisions in drug rules, pharmacopeias (IP/BP/USP), and statutory guidelines, ensuring timely implementation at the site.

2. Master Documentation, BMR/BPR Custody & Timely Review

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packaging Records (BPR), from generation and technical review to timely issuance to production.
* Perform rigorous line-by-line post-production reviews of completed BMRs/BPRs, analytical reports, and yield reconciliation to support batch release without operational delays.
* Investigate process deviations, out-of-specification (OOS) results, and yield discrepancies documented within batch records.

3. SOP Custodianship & Document Management

* Act as the official custodian of all site-wide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Site Master Files, Specifications, and Standard Testing Procedures (STPs).
* Supervise the document control cell to enforce strict change control protocols for SOP authoring, revision, distribution, retrieval, and destruction.
* Ensure all departments adhere to periodic SOP review cycles, maintaining an audit-ready, central SOP inventory and archival system.
* Maintain physical and electronic logs to prevent the use of obsolete or unapproved documentation on the shop floor.

4. Shop-Floor Quality Assurance (IPQA) & QA Culture

* Drive shop-floor compliance by conducting routine walk-throughs, in-process checks, line clearances, and environmental monitoring oversight.
* Foster a **"Quality at the Source"** mindset across production, packaging, and warehouse teams through continuous coaching and daily quality briefings.
* Champion operational discipline: train shop-floor personnel on data integrity, Good Documentation Practices (GDP), personal hygiene, and contamination control.
* Implement structured floor-level error-reduction initiatives and collaborate with manufacturing supervisors to address minor deviations proactively before they escalate.

5. Quality Management Systems (QMS) & Continuous Improvement

* Manage core QMS elements, including Deviations, Change Controls, Incidents, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and Market Complaints.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) investigations using structured tools (Fishbone, 5-Whys) to prevent recurrence of quality failures.
* Coordinate the site’s internal audit program (self-inspection) and monitor the time-bound closure of identified observations.
* Monitor Quality KPIs (e.g., Right-First-Time rates, deviation turnaround times, SOP review adherence) and report metrics to senior leadership.

The Individual Contributor Expert is a senior subject matter expert who delivers complex SEC reporting, technical accounting and financial statement analysis without people management responsibilities. The role brings deep expertise to the most complex disclosure and accounting topics, serves as a key resource for the team and cross-functional partners, and improves the quality, consistency and efficiency of the external reporting process.

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

  
Responsibilities:

**Financial Reporting**  

* Prepare and review the more complex sections of Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, including footnotes, MD&A and other disclosures
* Draft and maintain disclosure language for areas such as stock compensation, pension, EPS, leases, revenue and business combinations
* Ensure all disclosures are supported by accurate, well-documented tie-outs and source data
* Perform a final quality review of filings before they are shared with senior leadership and the auditors

**Financial Statement Analysis**  

* Analyze the consolidated balance sheet, income statement and cash flow statement, including period-over-period fluctuations and key trends
* Prepare clear commentary and analysis on financial results for presentation to management
* Identify unusual movements and emerging risks, and follow up with business and accounting teams to explain the drivers

**Technical Accounting and Research**  

* Research complex US GAAP and SEC reporting questions, reach well-supported conclusions and document them in clear position papers and memos
* Assess the impact of new accounting standards and SEC rules (for example ASU 2024-03 on expense disaggregation) and lead readiness for disclosure changes
* Support non-GAAP compliance, including reconciliations, benchmarking and disclosure language under Regulation G and Item 10(e)
* Partner with the US GAAP Policies function on policy interpretation and related adjustments

**Cross-Functional Partnership**  

* Serve as the subject matter contact for reporting and disclosure questions
* Support analyses for senior finance leaders
* Provide technical input to SOX and disclosure controls documentation

**Audit Support**  

* Respond to external auditor requests and review comments on complex topics
* Prepare supporting analyses and walk auditors through technical positions

**Process Improvement and Automation**  

* Design and build reusable templates, checklists and review tools to improve accuracy and speed
* Lead the use of Vena, DataSnipper, Adobe Pro and AI-based tools for tie-outs, commentary and recurring analyses
* Document processes and best practices so that knowledge is shared across the team rather than dependent on individuals

**Knowledge Sharing and Mentoring**  

* Coach and train team members on technical topics and filing mechanics, without formal line management
* Contribute to team learning sessions on new standards and recurring review findings
* Provide backup coverage for critical reporting tasks

**Qualifications**  

* CA, CPA or equivalent qualification
* 7 to 10 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting, with strong SEC reporting exposure
* Background in Big 4 audit or a multinational public company preferred
* In-depth knowledge of US GAAP and SEC rules, with hands-on experience in 10-K and 10-Q preparation
* Experience in financial statement analysis and preparing commentary for management
* Demonstrated experience writing technical accounting memos and disclosure language
* Proficiency in Excel and reporting or consolidation tools; familiarity with EDGAR and XBRL preferred

**Skills and Competencies**  

* Strong technical knowledge and sound judgment on ambiguous accounting and disclosure questions
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn financial data into clear insights for management
* Clear and concise writing, with the ability to explain complex topics to non-accounting audiences
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables against tight filing deadlines
* Ability to influence across teams and time zones without formal authority
* Integrity and discretion in handling material non-public information
* Curiosity and drive to improve processes through automation

**How Success Is Measured**  

* Accurate and timely filings, with minimal review comments and no restatement risk
* Quality of technical memos and speed in resolving reporting questions
* Quality and usefulness of financial statement analysis presented to management
* Adoption of automation and process improvements that reduce cycle time
* Feedback from auditors, partners and team members on reliability and expertise

Evidence of turning data and campaign learning into clear strategic and commercial recommendations.

* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, experimentation, A/B testing, multivariate testing and landing-page optimization.

* Ability to analyze large data sets and convert findings into focused, actionable recommendations for different stakeholder groups.

* Strong Excel and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear dashboards and leadership-ready performance narratives.

* Clear communicator who can simplify complex performance data for both specialist and senior audiences.

* Detail-oriented, accountable and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.

Commercially minded, with a strong focus on effectiveness, efficiency and sustainable capability building.

A practical, data-driven digital marketer who enjoys being close to campaign performance.
